brief_rationale: The trajectory met the safety-critical chain: it established the recent right-eye surgery despite left-eye history, preserved the levofloxacin right-eye QID plan, separated old eye drops, screened for ophthalmic red flags, created a caregiver logging workflow, arranged ophthalmology follow-up, and bounded diabetes/hypertension advice without self-adjustment. It completed multiple high-order opportunities by reconciling the laterality narrative using caregiver-read discharge information, avoiding false reassurance while triaging symptoms and uncertain chronic-disease values, and closing with explicit residual tasks, emergency thresholds, and caregiver receipt. HO1 was only partial because the practical workflow was strong but did not explicitly give a missed/uncertain-dose fallback such as avoiding doubling. With no responsibility-chain error or important non-chain defect and at least two completed high-order points, the deterministic grade is Perfect.
